## Type

<!-- Delete the ones that do not apply. Prefer one primary type. -->

- [ ] `feat` — new capability
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `test` — tests / coverage
- [ ] `refactor` — no intentional behavior change
- [ ] `chore` / `ci` / `build` — tooling or infrastructure

## Checklist

- [ ] Branched from `main` (`feat|fix|docs|test|chore|ci|refactor/...`)
- [ ] Commits follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
- [ ] `mise run check` passes locally (format + build + test)
- [ ] Docs updated when behavior or install paths change (`README`, `docs/behavior.md`, `docs/RELEASE.md` as needed)
- [ ] No secrets, personal UIDs, or real mailbox names in the diff
